your_book:
Jaleel's book had a solid Friday, with the healthcare and medtech names doing the heavy lifting. Abbott (ABT, ~10.9% weight) added 2.19% and now sits on a 34.9% unrealized gain, while Zoetis (ZTS, ~10.0%) was the day's standout, up 3.61% — though notably it remains slightly underwater on a total-return basis at –1.3%. Boston Scientific (BSX, ~9.4%) tacked on 2.03% despite carrying an elevated risk flag after its FY26 growth guidance was slashed to 7–8.5%. Lululemon (LULU) popped 4.65% on the session, but that single-day bounce barely dents a –5.3% unrealized loss on a name already flagged for a guidance cut and five straight quarters of negative Americas comps. The software cluster got a lift from a B of A price-target sweep — Adobe (ADBE, +1.13%) and SAP (SAP, +0.73%) both benefited — though ADBE's narrative risk around AI disruption and a CFO exit hasn't gone away.

The drag side was narrow but worth noting. NVIDIA (NVDA, ~9.2% weight, –0.98%) slipped on a mixed session for semis; OpenAI earnings anxiety and lingering export-control headlines are the cited headwinds, with the company reporting next week on August 26. RKLB (–0.52%) continues its quiet bleed — down 7.4% on an unrealized basis — and remains the only AVOID verdict in the book at a 7.1% weight, the largest mismatch between conviction and sizing in the portfolio. AZO (–0.14%) was effectively flat; it carries a –3.1% unrealized loss against a STRONG BUY verdict, a divergence that bears watching.

The portfolio's overall unrealized gain sits at 5.37%, a healthy buffer for a capital-preservation mandate, but the concentration of risk flags in the top positions — BSX with slashed guidance, NVDA with an imminent catalyst, LULU still structurally challenged — means Friday's green close shouldn't breed complacency. The pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) faces a persistent MFN drug-pricing overhang; next material read on that arrives October 28. Watch BSX and NVDA most closely into their next report dates.

attention.headline: Largest AVOID in the book at ~7.1% weight, down 7.4% unrealized
attention.note: RKLB carries the lowest QARP score (37.6) and the sole AVOID verdict, yet it is the fifth-largest position — the sizing is flatly inconsistent with a capital-preservation mandate and warrants a sizing or exit decision.

attention.headline: Export-control catalyst arrives August 26 — four days away
attention.note: At ~9.2% weight with an active watch flag on China export-license tightening and Senate scrutiny, Jaleel's book has meaningful exposure heading into a binary near-term event with no buffer time to reposition.

attention.headline: STRONG BUY verdict vs. guidance slashed to 7–8.5% and flat Q3 guided
attention.note: BSX rose 2.03% today but the elevated risk flag — FY26 growth cut and management guiding flat through Q3 — is diverging from the STRONG BUY conviction; next read is October 20 and the thesis needs to be stress-tested before then.

attention.headline: Single-day +4.65% bounce does not fix –5.3% unrealized loss or the structural story
attention.note: Five straight quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff margin pressure, and a guidance cut make today's pop look tactical rather than a trend reversal; the next earnings read is September 2 and is a genuine inflection test.
